stories.summary: The first train has entered the Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority's (MMRDA's) Kasheli Depot, marking a milestone in preparations for Mumbai Metro Line-5. The arrival brings the depot’s role into focus: Kasheli will be the base where trains for the Thane–Bhiwandi–Kalyan corridor are parked, inspected, tested and maintained.

stories.title: Thane to host 27th Mayor's Cup National Photography Exhibition from November 19

stories.summary: The National People's Party (NPP) has urged the Nagaland Governor to initiate a comprehensive constitutional and legal examination of the applicability of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, and its subsequent amendments in the State in the context of Article 371A of the Constitution.

stories.summary: The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) on Tuesday revoked restrictions under Stage III of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) in Delhi-NCR, citing a downward trend in the daily Air Quality Index (AQI), which stood at 204. stories.summary: The Maharashtra government has placed Force One, the state's specialised commando unit, under the administrative and operational control of the Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS) .
